g.text: JMJD3 dependence: direct genotype × DFMO contrasts
GSE162382 | 68-hour bulk RNA | 4 WT + 3 conditional-KO animal labels, paired treatment cultures
Endpoint: (DFMO − vehicle)KO − (DFMO − vehicle)WT on the fitted log₂ RNA-abundance scale.
Dots: estimates; bars: 95% moderated model intervals. Filled dots: BH q ≤ 0.05 across all tested genes in that contrast.
Positive: the KO response is more positive (or less negative); negative: more negative (or less positive).
An interaction is not a mediation test. Open points do not establish equivalence. Intervals are conditional on this model and source labels;
physical specimen independence is unverified. The twelve genes were fixed in the earlier descriptive contract.
